units.name: units
units.description: Set the unit system for the simulation. All physical quantities are defined in terms of the chosen unit system.

atom_style.name: atom_style
atom_style.description: Define the attributes associated with each atom. Determines what per-atom data is stored and communicated.

dimension.name: dimension
dimension.description: Set the dimensionality of the simulation. Must be set before the simulation box is defined.

boundary.name: boundary
boundary.description: Set the boundary conditions for each dimension of the simulation box. Controls periodicity and shrink-wrapping.

newton.name: newton
newton.description: Turn Newton's 3rd law on or off for pairwise and bonded interactions. Affects communication patterns for parallel runs.

processors.name: processors
processors.description: Specify how processors are mapped to the 3D simulation box. Allows explicit control of the processor grid decomposition.

comm_style.name: comm_style
comm_style.description: Set the style of inter-processor communication of atom information. Brick is default; tiled allows irregular decomposition.

comm_modify.name: comm_modify
comm_modify.description: Modify parameters of the inter-processor communication. Controls cutoff, mode, and velocity communication.

lattice.name: lattice
lattice.description: Define a lattice for use by create_atoms and other geometry commands. Sets the lattice type and scale factor.

region.name: region
region.description: Define a geometric region of space. Used by create_atoms, delete_atoms, fix wall, group, and other commands.

create_box.name: create_box
create_box.description: Create a simulation box based on a previously defined region. Defines the number of atom types and optional bond/angle/dihedral/improper types.

create_atoms.name: create_atoms
create_atoms.description: Create atoms on a lattice or at specified positions within the simulation box. Supports single atoms, random placement, and lattice filling.

mass.name: mass
mass.description: Set the mass of an atom type. Required for all atom types before a simulation can be run.

replicate.name: replicate
replicate.description: Replicate the simulation box in each dimension. Creates a larger system by tiling the current box.

read_data.name: read_data
read_data.description: Read a LAMMPS data file containing atom coordinates, topology, and force-field coefficients. Primary way to define a molecular system.

read_restart.name: read_restart
read_restart.description: Read a previously saved binary restart file to continue a simulation. Restores atom positions, velocities, and force-field settings.

read_dump.name: read_dump
read_dump.description: Read atom coordinates from a dump file snapshot and assign them to the current simulation. Useful for post-processing or restarting from dump files.

write_data.name: write_data
write_data.description: Write the current simulation state to a LAMMPS data file. Can be used to save the system for later read_data or as a checkpoint.

write_restart.name: write_restart
write_restart.description: Write a binary restart file of the current simulation state. Restart files store all information needed to continue a simulation.

write_dump.name: write_dump
write_dump.description: Write a snapshot of atom data to a dump file at the current timestep. Useful for one-time output without setting up a recurring dump.

include.name: include
include.description: Read and execute commands from another LAMMPS input script file. Allows modular script organization.

pair_style.name: pair_style
pair_style.description: Set the formula(s) LAMMPS uses to compute pairwise interactions. Must be set before pair_coeff. The choice determines what arguments pair_coeff requires.

pair_coeff.name: pair_coeff
pair_coeff.description: Specify pairwise force-field coefficients for one or more pairs of atom types. Arguments depend on the pair_style in use.

pair_modify.name: pair_modify
pair_modify.description: Modify parameters of the currently defined pair style. Can change mixing rules, tail corrections, table settings, and more.

pair_write.name: pair_write
pair_write.description: Write a table of the currently defined pairwise energy and force to a file. Useful for verifying or visualizing the pair potential.

bond_style.name: bond_style
bond_style.description: Set the formula LAMMPS uses to compute bond interactions between bonded atom pairs. Required before bond_coeff.

bond_coeff.name: bond_coeff
bond_coeff.description: Specify bond coefficients for a particular bond type. Arguments depend on the bond_style.

bond_write.name: bond_write
bond_write.description: Write a table of the currently defined bond energy and force as a function of distance to a file.

angle_style.name: angle_style
angle_style.description: Set the formula for computing angle interactions between triplets of bonded atoms.

angle_coeff.name: angle_coeff
angle_coeff.description: Specify angle coefficients for a particular angle type. Arguments depend on the angle_style.

dihedral_style.name: dihedral_style
dihedral_style.description: Set the formula for computing dihedral (torsional) interactions between quadruplets of bonded atoms.

dihedral_coeff.name: dihedral_coeff
dihedral_coeff.description: Specify dihedral coefficients for a particular dihedral type. Arguments depend on the dihedral_style.

improper_style.name: improper_style
improper_style.description: Set the formula for computing improper (out-of-plane) interactions between quadruplets of atoms.

improper_coeff.name: improper_coeff
improper_coeff.description: Specify improper coefficients for a particular improper type. Arguments depend on the improper_style.

kspace_style.name: kspace_style
kspace_style.description: Define a long-range solver for Coulomb or dispersion interactions. Required when using pair styles with long-range components (e.g., coul/long).

kspace_modify.name: kspace_modify
kspace_modify.description: Modify parameters of the long-range kspace solver. Controls mesh size, order, slab correction, and other solver-specific settings.

special_bonds.name: special_bonds
special_bonds.description: Set weighting factors for 1-2, 1-3, and 1-4 pairwise interactions. Controls how bonded atoms interact via pair potentials.

neighbor.name: neighbor
neighbor.description: Set parameters that affect the building of pairwise neighbor lists. Controls the skin distance and binning style.

neigh_modify.name: neigh_modify
neigh_modify.description: Modify parameters of the neighbor list build process. Controls rebuild frequency, delay, communication settings, and exclusions.

fix.name: fix
fix.description: Apply a fix to the simulation. Fixes perform operations during timestepping: time integration, constraints, force modifications, diagnostics, and more. Each fix has a unique ID and applies to a group of atoms.

unfix.name: unfix
unfix.description: Remove a previously defined fix from the simulation.

fix_modify.name: fix_modify
fix_modify.description: Modify parameters of a previously defined fix. Can change energy/virial contributions, temperature/pressure compute IDs, and other fix-specific settings.

compute.name: compute
compute.description: Define a computation that will be performed on atoms or the system. Computes do not produce output directly; use thermo_style, dump, or fix ave/time to access computed values.

uncompute.name: uncompute
uncompute.description: Remove a previously defined compute from the simulation.

compute_modify.name: compute_modify
compute_modify.description: Modify parameters of a previously defined compute. Can change the dynamic flag or extra/dof settings.

thermo.name: thermo
thermo.description: Set the frequency (in timesteps) for printing thermodynamic output to the screen and log file.

thermo_style.name: thermo_style
thermo_style.description: Set the style and content of thermodynamic output. Custom style allows choosing specific quantities (step, temp, pe, ke, etotal, press, vol, density, etc.).

thermo_modify.name: thermo_modify
thermo_modify.description: Modify thermo output settings: temperature/pressure compute IDs, lost atom behavior, output format, and flushing.

dump.name: dump
dump.description: Define a dump command to write atom snapshots to a file periodically during a simulation. Supports multiple output formats.

dump_modify.name: dump_modify
dump_modify.description: Modify parameters of a previously defined dump command. Controls element names, sorting, file format details, thresholds, and more.

undump.name: undump
undump.description: Delete a previously defined dump command so that it no longer produces output.

restart.name: restart
restart.description: Write periodic restart files during a simulation. Alternates between two filenames for safety.

velocity.name: velocity
velocity.description: Set or modify velocities of atoms. Can create initial velocities from a temperature distribution, set explicit values, or ramp velocities.

set.name: set
set.description: Set per-atom properties for atoms matching a selection criterion. Can set type, charge, position, velocity, image flags, and more.

group.name: group
group.description: Define a named group of atoms based on type, region, ID, molecule, or Boolean operations. Groups are used by fix, compute, dump, and other commands.

delete_atoms.name: delete_atoms
delete_atoms.description: Delete atoms from the simulation based on group, region, overlap distance, or random selection.

delete_bonds.name: delete_bonds
delete_bonds.description: Delete bonds (and optionally angles, dihedrals, impropers) based on type, group membership, or other criteria.

displace_atoms.name: displace_atoms
displace_atoms.description: Displace a group of atoms by a fixed vector, random amount, or via rotation.

change_box.name: change_box
change_box.description: Change the simulation box dimensions or shape and remap atoms accordingly.

reset_atoms.name: reset_atoms
reset_atoms.description: Reset atom IDs to be contiguous (1 to N) after atoms have been deleted.

atom_modify.name: atom_modify
atom_modify.description: Modify properties of the atom style before the simulation box is created. Controls atom ID assignment, sorting, and mapping.

variable.name: variable
variable.description: Define a variable for use in other commands. Variables can be simple strings, loops, mathematical expressions, per-atom formulas, or references to external files and Python functions.

run.name: run
run.description: Run the simulation for N timesteps. Invokes the time integrator (fix nve/nvt/npt) and all other fixes/computes/dumps.

minimize.name: minimize
minimize.description: Perform an energy minimization of the system using the current min_style algorithm. Iterates until convergence criteria are met.

min_style.name: min_style
min_style.description: Set the minimization algorithm used by the minimize command.

min_modify.name: min_modify
min_modify.description: Modify parameters of the minimization algorithm (line search parameters, convergence settings).

neb.name: neb
neb.description: Perform a nudged elastic band (NEB) calculation to find the minimum energy pathway between an initial and final state.

prd.name: prd
prd.description: Perform a parallel replica dynamics (PRD) simulation for accelerating rare event detection across multiple replicas.

tad.name: tad
tad.description: Perform a temperature accelerated dynamics (TAD) simulation to accelerate rare events by running at elevated temperature.

hyper.name: hyper
hyper.description: Perform a hyperdynamics simulation to accelerate rare events using a bias potential.

temper.name: temper
temper.description: Perform a parallel tempering (replica exchange) simulation. Requires running LAMMPS with multiple partitions.

rerun.name: rerun
rerun.description: Re-process snapshots from a dump file, computing forces/energies for each snapshot without time integration. Useful for post-processing.

timestep.name: timestep
timestep.description: Set the timestep size for subsequent MD runs. Units depend on the units command setting.

reset_timestep.name: reset_timestep
reset_timestep.description: Reset the current timestep counter to a specified value. Useful after equilibration or when restarting.

clear.name: clear
clear.description: Delete all atoms, restore all settings to their default values, and prepare for a new simulation. Equivalent to starting a fresh LAMMPS instance.

label.name: label
label.description: Define a label that can be jumped to with the jump command. Used for scripting control flow.

jump.name: jump
jump.description: Jump to a label in the current input script or to a different input script file. Used for looping and conditional execution.

next.name: next
next.description: Advance one or more variables to their next value (for index, loop, file, universe, uloop styles). Used in loops.

if.name: if
if.description: Conditionally execute one or more LAMMPS commands based on a Boolean expression. Supports then/elif/else clauses.

print.name: print
print.description: Print a string to the screen and/or log file immediately. Can include variable substitutions and be appended to a file.

log.name: log
log.description: Switch the log file where thermodynamic output is written. Can also turn off logging.

echo.name: echo
echo.description: Control whether input script commands are echoed to the screen and/or log file as they are read.

info.name: info
info.description: Print information about the current LAMMPS setup: system, communication, computes, dumps, fixes, groups, regions, variables, etc.

timer.name: timer
timer.description: Control the granularity and format of LAMMPS timing information output at end of run.

shell.name: shell
shell.description: Execute a shell command from within a LAMMPS input script. Can run external programs, create directories, etc.

python.name: python
python.description: Define a Python function that can be called from a LAMMPS input script via the variable python style or as a direct invocation.

balance.name: balance
balance.description: Perform a one-time static load balance of atoms across processors. Adjusts sub-domain boundaries to equalize atom counts or computational cost.

partition.name: partition
partition.description: Execute a command on a subset of partitions when LAMMPS is running with multiple partitions (e.g., for replica exchange or NEB).

suffix.name: suffix
suffix.description: Enable use of accelerated styles by appending a suffix (gpu, intel, kk, omp, opt) to style names.

package.name: package
package.description: Configure settings for an accelerator package (gpu, intel, kokkos, omp, opt). Controls number of threads, GPUs, etc.

molecule.name: molecule
molecule.description: Define a molecule template from a file. Used by create_atoms, fix deposit, fix pour, fix gcmc, and other commands to insert molecules.

labelmap.name: labelmap
labelmap.description: Define a mapping between numeric type IDs and string labels for atom, bond, angle, dihedral, and improper types.

run_style.name: run_style
run_style.description: Set the style of time integrator used for MD runs. Options include Verlet and respa (rRESPA multi-timescale).

dielectric.name: dielectric
dielectric.description: Set the dielectric constant for Coulomb interactions. All Coulomb pair styles multiply the energy and force by this factor.

box.name: box
box.description: Set attributes of the simulation box. Currently controls the tilt limit for triclinic boxes.

create_bonds.name: create_bonds
create_bonds.description: Create bonds between atom pairs based on distance criteria or explicit atom ID pairs. Can also create single bonds, angles, dihedrals.

minimize/kk.name: minimize/kk
minimize/kk.description: Kokkos-accelerated version of the minimize command for energy minimization.

neb/spin.name: neb/spin
neb/spin.description: Perform a nudged elastic band (NEB) calculation for spin systems to find the minimum energy pathway between spin configurations.

temper/npt.name: temper/npt
temper/npt.description: Perform parallel tempering (replica exchange) with NPT ensemble. Swaps both temperature and pressure between replicas.

temper/grem.name: temper/grem
temper/grem.description: Perform generalized replica exchange method (gREM) simulation for enhanced sampling of complex free-energy landscapes.

fitpod.name: fitpod
fitpod.description: Fit a Proper Orthogonal Decomposition (POD) machine learning interatomic potential to training data within LAMMPS.

third_order.name: third_order
third_order.description: Compute the third-order force constants (anharmonic) using finite differences. Used for phonon-phonon scattering calculations.

dynamical_matrix.name: dynamical_matrix
dynamical_matrix.description: Compute the dynamical matrix (second-order force constants) of the system using finite differences. Used for phonon calculations.

kim.name: kim
kim.description: Interface to the KIM (Knowledgebase of Interatomic Models) API. Allows use of any KIM-compliant interatomic potential model.

mdi.name: mdi
mdi.description: Configure the MolSSI Driver Interface (MDI) for coupling LAMMPS to external codes as a driver or engine.

plugin.name: plugin
plugin.description: Load or query LAMMPS style plugins from shared libraries at runtime.

message.name: message
message.description: Setup messaging for client/server coupling between LAMMPS and another code using CSlib.

server.name: server
server.description: Operate LAMMPS in server mode, listening for commands from a client program via the CSlib messaging library.

angle_write.name: angle_write
angle_write.description: Write a table of the currently defined angle energy and force as a function of angle to a file.

dihedral_write.name: dihedral_write
dihedral_write.description: Write a table of the currently defined dihedral energy and torque as a function of dihedral angle to a file.

write_coeff.name: write_coeff
write_coeff.description: Write the current force-field coefficients (pair, bond, angle, dihedral, improper) to a file in a format readable by read_data.

reset_mol_ids.name: reset_mol_ids
reset_mol_ids.description: Reset molecule IDs for a group of atoms based on bond connectivity. Assigns contiguous molecule IDs from 1 to Nmols.

group2ndx.name: group2ndx
group2ndx.description: Write a GROMACS-style index file (.ndx) for the currently defined groups. Useful for cross-code analysis workflows.

ndx2group.name: ndx2group
ndx2group.description: Read a GROMACS-style index file (.ndx) and create LAMMPS groups from the index entries.
